item.title: A Rare 1974 Interview with Freddie Mercury (+ Deluxe ‘Queen II’ Set Coming)
item.description: “We do rock ’n’ roll, and our presentation is just a way of putting across the music. We view albums and concerts as two spheres of work. There’s a different level in the studio as compared to when you’re on stage. But when we’re before an audience, we let loose.”—Mercury The post A Rare 1974 Interview with Freddie Mercury (+ Deluxe ‘Queen II’ Set Coming) appeared first on Best Classic Bands.
